about: Code that is no longer used but not removed yet. Nothing here moves: an entry only notes it. tools/check_quarantine.py fails once an entry is 14 days old and `usage` (a regular expression for calls, not the definition) still finds nothing; then the code is removed together with its entry. If `usage` finds calls again, the entry is dropped.

entries.name: Routing select of the graph inspector
entries.reason: Connections are made by dragging; the routing select ("Next") was removed from the inspector.

entries.name: Project and WorkItem repositories
entries.reason: Left over from the first iteration; no production code imports repositories/, only tests/test_repositories.py. Use ignore ["apps/backend/tests/*"] so that test does not keep it alive; removal takes that test with it. tasks/repository.py and graph/repository.py are the live persistence convention.

entries.name: BOARD_STATUSES
entries.reason: No reference at all; migration 0002 keeps its own copy.

entries.name: Project and WorkItem models (and WorkItemStatus)
entries.reason: Only repositories/ and tests use them (use ignore ["apps/backend/openartifact/repositories/*", "apps/backend/tests/*"]). Removing them needs migration 0021 that drops work_items and projects, removal of the tables' assertions in tests/test_migrations.py and tests/test_tasks.py, and the 05.03 wording. The models now declare the migrations' indexes so alembic check stays green while they exist.

entries.name: PipelineError
entries.reason: Defined in the exception hierarchy but never raised or caught anywhere.

entries.name: DatabaseError and its 503 handler
entries.reason: Nothing in the product raises it, so the handler in app.py (_handle_db_error) cannot fire except in a synthetic test (use ignore ["apps/backend/tests/*"]). Either wrap sqlalchemy OperationalError in get_db_session and use it, or delete the class and handler.

entries.name: ApiError re-export in tasks/api.js
entries.reason: No module imports ApiError from tasks/api.js.

entries.name: Re-export of HEADER, SLOTS, slotY in geometry.js
entries.reason: No importer takes these names from geometry.js.

entries.name: DeleteTaskDialog
entries.reason: The board deletes through ConfirmDialog (subject, note, Cancel lock, 404 treated as success in the caller).
